label: STATIC_AS_OF
note: Synthetic checks are separate from the public-RPC smoke. Neither is a profitability claim. The 24-hour trial is not started.

blockers.detail: This coding run is a Cursor cloud agent VM. Nothing started here keeps running after the run ends, and there is no supervisor to restart it. A 24-hour loop was not started, so there is no start time, end time, or heartbeat.

On 2026-11-07 the public endpoint https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com answered getSlot and a few paced getTransaction calls, then returned JSON-RPC error 429 when transactions were requested in a burst. No Helius API key is configured. A 24-hour logsSubscribe session was not opened and is not verified.
The repository has no data/raw tape, no data/windows.json, and no credits ledger. The 666-wallet study cannot be replayed from checked-in observations.

twentyFourHourTrial.reason: This process is a bounded smoke read on a cloud agent VM. The 24-hour clock is armed only by paper/host/run.mjs on a persistent host.

notSelected.copy: No wallet was chosen before this sample, and the advertised 80% list is not evidence.
notSelected.graduation: The virtual-SOL gauge is not a verified migration test, and there is no bonding-curve sell after complete.

evaluation.note: No fill. A sniper entry needs a verified create instruction and reserves in the same sample. This sample did not have one.
